import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import pytest

# Import the public API that is available in the codebase
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.types import UID, Level
from doorstop.core.vcs.mockvcs import WorkingCopy as MockWorkingCopy


# Helper to create a temporary Doorstop project
@pytest.fixture
def doorstop_project(tmp_path):
    """Create a minimal Doorstop project in a temporary directory."""
    # Create a mock working copy to satisfy VCS expectations
    wc = MockWorkingCopy(str(tmp_path))
    # Create a document with a prefix
    doc = Document.new(wc, prefix="DOC", path=str(tmp_path))
    yield doc
    # Clean up
    shutil.rmtree(tmp_path, ignore_errors=True)


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_001_permanent_and_secure_storage_of_requirements(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    [REQ011] Doorstop shall store requirements in a permanent and secure manner.
    """
    doc = doorstop_project

    # Store a requirement
    uid = UID("REQ-001")
    item = Item.new(doc.tree, doc, doc.path, doc.root, uid, level=Level.load_level(1))
    item.set_attributes({"text": "Test requirement", "active": True})
    item.save()

    # Retrieve the requirement
    retrieved = doc.find_item(uid)
    assert retrieved is not None, "Requirement should be retrievable"
    assert retrieved.text == "Test requirement", "Requirement text should match"
    assert retrieved.active is True, "Requirement should be active"

    # Ensure the file exists on disk (permanent storage)
    item_path = os.path.join(doc.path, f"{uid}.md")
    assert os.path.isfile(item_path), "Requirement file should exist on disk"


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_002_change_management_of_requirements(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    [REQ012] Doorstop shall handle change management of the requirements.
    """
    doc = doorstop_project

    # Create initial requirement
    uid = UID("REQ-002")
    item = Item.new(doc.tree, doc, doc.path, doc.root, uid, level=Level.load_level(1))
    item.set_attributes({"text": "Initial requirement", "active": True})
    item.save()

    # Apply change to requirement
    item.text = "Updated requirement details"
    item.save()

    # Retrieve updated requirement
    updated = doc.find_item(uid)
    assert updated.text == "Updated requirement details", "Requirement should reflect change"
    assert updated.active is True, "Active status should remain unchanged"


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_003_associating_requirements_changes_to_developer_identification(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    [REQ013] Doorstop shall associate requirements changes to existing developer identification.
    """
    pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No API to associate developer IDs with changes in the current codebase.")


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_004_scalability_for_thousands_of_requirements(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    [REQ014] Doorstop shall be scalable to support thousands of requirements.
    """
    doc = doorstop_project
    num_requirements = 1000

    # Store multiple requirements
    for i in range(num_requirements):
        uid = UID(f"REQ-{i:04d}")
        item = Item.new(doc.tree, doc, doc.path, doc.root, uid, level=Level.load_level(1))
        item.set_attributes({"text": f"Requirement {i}", "active": True})
        item.save()

    # Retrieve a requirement to ensure performance
    sample_uid = UID("REQ-0500")
    retrieved = doc.find_item(sample_uid)
    assert retrieved is not None, "Sample requirement should be retrievable"
    assert retrieved.text == "Requirement 500", "Sample requirement text should match"


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_005_lightweight_installation_method(
    doorstop_project,
):
    """
    [REQ015] Doorstop shall provide a lightweight installation method.
    """
    pytest.skip("NOT_AUTOMATABLE: Installation method verification requires environment inspection.")
